mechanism: Both drugs have CNS depressant effects and zolpidem may potentiate levodopa-induced dyskinesias and psychomotor impairment; levodopa can increase dopaminergic activity which may alter zolpidem efficacy.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, confusion, and worsening dyskinesias; consider dose adjustment or alternative hypnotic if adverse effects emerge; separate dosing times when possible.
